target_customer: At founding, Indian doctors paying for a prescription and records app; now consumers and B2B health platforms using 30 minute medicine delivery
problem: Indian doctors wrote slow, illegible paper prescriptions and patient records were not digitised; later, buying medicines quickly and reliably was hard.
business_model: Doctor subscription (premium plan) at founding; medicine delivery margin and B2B API and SDK today
product_category: Digital health, EMR then quick commerce pharmacy

founders.name: Aman Bhandula
education: IIT Roorkee (studied four years, per YC page and Indian Express headline calling him an IIT dropout)
founders.background_notes: Education from the YC company page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and handwriting prescription tools trained for Indian accents are moderately hard; the later delivery model adds logistics and pharmacy operations.

defensibility.rationale: EMR apps and quick medicine delivery both faced funded rivals and low switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large online pharmacies and Practo stayed dominant; no source shows them copying or buying Farmako.

market_need_then: Inc42 (Dec 2020) reports about 1,500 doctors onboarded in a year with over 400 on a premium plan and about 300 medicine orders a day after adding delivery, company reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses farmako.ai now; earlier domain farmako.in per directory listings.

identity.voice_and_tone: Speed focused: fastest medicine delivery in 30 minutes

brand_strength.rationale: Regional startup press only; a similarly named German cannabis company causes search confusion.

pivots.from: AI EMR app for doctors and lab records SaaS
pivots.to: 30 minute medicine delivery with ABHA Health ID records
pivots.why: Company says it launched quick medicine delivery in 2023 and moved to ABHA Health ID for records after the government launched it in 2022

outcome_analysis: Farmako is active with about 40 people and over 15,000 orders a month per its YC page. It started as a doctor prescription and records app, raised 1.5M in 2020, then pivoted in 2023 to quick medicine delivery. Funding since has been small, 1.6M in 2024 and a pre-Series A top-up in 2025, and it faces much larger pharmacy rivals, so the outcome is unproven.
notes: Company site farmako.ai returned 403 so was not read. The 2024 round was also reported by BW Disrupt and FinSMEs. Inc42 summary said 1.5 Bn but the body said 1.5 Mn; recorded as 1.5M. Sources disagree on founding year (2018, 2019, 2020). A Germany based Farmako (cannabis) is unrelated. The 2020 competitor list is from the Dec 2020 Inc42 article, after the Summer 2020 batch start.
